newsitem.title: USA: Blue chips retain modest gain after giving back big gains.
newsitem.headline: Blue chips retain modest gain after giving back big gains.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks ended slightly higher Friday after a session of violent swings that were mostly linked to the so-called triple-witching expirations of December stock index futures, futures on options and individual stock options.
Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow was up 10.76 points at 6,484.40. An early surge of nearly 65 points to 6,548.99 put the index a shade above its record close of 6,547.79 set on Nov. 25.
In the broader market, advancing issues swamped declines 15-9 on very heavy volume of 655 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
